newsitem.title: UK: Greece's Public Power seeks $250mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Greece's Public Power seeks $250mln loan.

text.p: LONDON, Sept 5 (LPC) - Greece's state-owned Public Power Corporation is seeking bank bids for a new $250 million syndicated loan, according to banking sources.

Banks are asked to submit bids for a credit with a five year maturity. Pricing is expected to be in the region of 45 bps to 50 bps over LIBOR, according to one banker. The proceeds will be used for general funding needs.

In May, Public Power Corporation sought and gained a pricing reduction on a $50 million credit put into place in 1994, cutting the margin to 50 bps from 82.5 bps. That deal was arranged by Sumitomo Bank.
Public Power Corporation has a long-term debt rating of BBB minus from Standard & Poor's.
